record.paper_title: Open problems on structure of positively curved projective varieties
record.original_question: Let (X,Δ) be a klt pair such that X is smooth and −(K_X+Δ) is nef. Does there exist an orbifold morphism ρ:(X,Δ)→(R,Δ_R) such that (R,Δ_R) is klt, R is smooth, c1(K_R+Δ_R)=0, the general orbifold fibers are slope rationally connected, and the fibration is locally trivial with respect to pairs, meaning that for every small open set U in R the pair (ρ^{-1}(U),Δ) is isomorphic over U to (U,Δ_R|_U)×(X_r,Δ_{X_r}) for a general fiber X_r?

evidence.quote: The MRC fibration is defined only by X, and thus it does not reflect information on the boundary ∆. On the other hand, the slope rationally connected quotient (sRC quotient for short), introduced in [9], gives a generalization of MRC fibrations reflecting the boundary ∆
This conjecture was solved when (X, ∆) is a log smooth surface in [10, Theorem 1.6], but it is still open in the general case.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. Let X be a smooth complex projective variety and Δ an effective Q-divisor on X such that the pair (X,Δ) is klt (Kawamata log terminal) and the anti-log-canonical divisor −(K_X+Δ) is nef.

Recall the following notions:
- An orbifold morphism ρ:(X,Δ)→(R,Δ_R) between klt pairs is a surjective morphism ρ:X→R compatible with the orbifold structures of Δ and Δ_R in the sense of Campana (i.e., the multiplicities of Δ are matched by ramification and by the multiplicities of Δ_R along divisors of R).
- A general orbifold fiber of ρ is the pair (X_r, Δ_{X_r}), where X_r=ρ^{-1}(r) for a general point r∈R and Δ_{X_r}=Δ|_{X_r}.
- The pair (X_r, Δ_{X_r}) is slope rationally connected (sRC) in the sense that any two general points can be joined by a chain of rational curves which are "free" with respect to the pair, generalizing rational connectedness to klt pairs.
- The fibration ρ is locally trivial with respect to pairs if for every sufficiently small open subset U⊂R there is an isomorphism (ρ^{-1}(U),Δ|_{ρ^{-1}(U)}) ≅ (U,Δ_R|_U) × (X_r,Δ_{X_r}) over U, where (X_r,Δ_{X_r}) is a general orbifold fiber.

Question. Does there always exist an orbifold morphism ρ:(X,Δ)→(R,Δ_R) such that:
(i) (R,Δ_R) is a klt pair with R smooth;
(ii) the numerical class c_1(K_R+Δ_R)=0;
(iii) the general orbifold fibers (X_r,Δ_{X_r}) are slope rationally connected;
(iv) ρ is locally trivial with respect to the pairs (X,Δ) and (R,Δ_R) in the sense above?
artifact.category_tag: klt pairs with nef anti-canonical divisor
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture (due to Campana–Cao–Matsumura) is known to hold when (X,Δ) is a log smooth surface, but in general dimensions it remains open. Subsequent work by Campana–Cao–Matsumura and others has established partial structure-theorem results for projective klt pairs with nef anti-canonical divisor, but the full conjecture combining sRC general fibers with pair-local-triviality over a klt base with numerically trivial log canonical class is not known in general.

status_evidence.title: Projective klt pairs with nef anti-canonical divisor (Campana–Cao–Matsumura)
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes Theorem 1.6 (the surface case of the conjecture) and states the general conjecture as open in higher dimension.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture is solved for log smooth surfaces but stated as open in general.

status_evidence.title: Structure theorem for projective klt pairs with nef anti-canonical divisor
status_evidence.snippet: Further partial structure results for klt pairs with nef anti-canonical divisor, contributing to but not fully resolving the sRC quotient conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress, conjecture not fully resolved in general dimension.
